description: Links are distinguished by color alone (no underline), an accessibility gap for color-vision-deficient guests. Add a non-color affordance (e.g. underline) to links across guest-facing pages.
title: Give links a non-color affordance (color-only-links a11y)
acceptance_criteria: Links carry a non-color affordance (e.g. underline) across guest-facing pages
design-reviewer confirms the change is tokens-only with no regression
